settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: OAuth 2.0 client id of a Google Cloud project (Web application). Empty = SIMULATED demonstration mode.

settings.label: Hosted domain (optional)
settings.help: Restrict to one Google Workspace domain (the token's hd claim must match).

authMethod.name: Google
authMethod.description: Federated sign-in with a Google account (OpenID Connect: issuer, audience, signature and nonce checks). The account must be explicitly linked to a local account; nothing is linked by e-mail match.

setupGuide.intro: Everything happens on this screen. Leave the Client ID empty to try the simulated demo mode (screen marked DEMO, fictional accounts).
steps: Open the {console} > APIs & services > Credentials > Create credentials > OAuth client ID (application type: Web application). See the {docs}.
Under Authorized redirect URIs, paste exactly:
Copy the generated Client ID and Client secret into the fields below, then Save.
Each person then links their Google account from their Profile page (Linked sign-in providers). No automatic linking by e-mail.
